entity_types.name: diary_entry
entity_types.desc: A single appended record in the diary, produced per settled turn, containing tool mix, event mix, closing words, duration, and end reason.

entity_types.name: diary_file
entity_types.desc: An append-only markdown file, one per node per day, holding diary entries.

entity_types.name: event
entity_types.desc: A message on the harness session/event stream, such as turn/end, session/disposed, blocked, interrupted, or forked.

entity_types.name: git_repository
entity_types.desc: A local git repo owned by the user (GitHub/Gitea/bare) where diary files are appended.

entity_types.name: plugin
entity_types.desc: A DeepSeek Harness extension that subscribes to harness event streams and performs a function, such as writing diary entries.

entity_types.name: settle_reason
entity_types.desc: The reason a turn settled, e.g. completed, error, max-tokens, aborted, blocked, interrupted, forked.

entity_types.name: sibling_tool
entity_types.desc: A related tool in the same family, such as the agentdiary CLI or dsh-super-agent.

entity_types.name: turn
entity_types.desc: A unit of agent work in the harness that settles with a reason such as completed, error, max-tokens, or aborted.

relation_types.name: subscribes_to
relation_types.desc: The plugin listens to a harness event stream.

relation_types.name: writes
relation_types.desc: The plugin appends a diary entry per settled turn.

relation_types.name: appends_to
relation_types.desc: Diary entries are appended into a diary file.

relation_types.name: stored_in
relation_types.desc: Diary files live inside the user-owned git repository.

relation_types.name: settles_with
relation_types.desc: A turn ends with a particular settle reason.

relation_types.name: triggers
relation_types.desc: A turn/end event with a settled reason triggers creation of a diary entry.

relation_types.name: sibling_of
relation_types.desc: The plugin is a sibling of related tools in the same family.
